correctness.rationale: Square-zero expansion over the stated dual ring is valid in every characteristic and reduces powers at m>=k to the kernel of T_m. Conjugating A reduces to independent ordered rectangular blocks. For sizes a,b, identify matrix units with u^{a-i}v^{j-1} in K[u,v]/(u^a,v^b). The operator multiplies by h_{m-1}; for d>=m-1 both u h_d and v h_d equal h_{d+1}, since u^{d+1}=v^{d+1}=0. Its image has exactly one nonzero generator in each grade m-1 through a+b-2 (each a sum of distinct monomials with coefficient one), and no others. This yields max(0,a+b-m) in every field. Rank-nullity gives the cumulative formula, differences give the point law, and reduction precludes indices below k. At 2k all terms vanish; at 2k-1 precisely the s^2 ordered pairs of largest blocks contribute. This includes k=1, where only B=0 gives index one. Independent bounded replay: python3 /workspace/reproduction.py 3 exhausts six dual-ring lift cases over F_2, F_3 and F_4 (including (2,2) over F_2, with bins 256,3840,61440), and computes ranks by literal dual powers on matrix units for (3,2) and (4,2,1) over F_2 (respectively 8,4,1,0 and 10,5,2,1,0). Bounded tests corroborate the proof and do not address higher-order coefficient rings.

evidence: After equation (6.5) the authors decompose L_m into ordered Jordan block pairs. For a p-by-q matrix unit Y_ij in their lower-Jordan convention, p. 21 gives L_m(Y_ij)e_1=e_{m+i-j} if 1<=m+i-j<=p and zero otherwise.
At m>=max(p,q), telescoping the very same sum gives J_p L_m(Y)-L_m(Y) J_q=J_p^mY-YJ_q^m=0. Since e_h=J_q^{h-1} e_1, column h of every output is J_p^{h-1} times its first column.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: Thus first-column projection is injective on the output image. From the published coordinate formula its image is exactly spanned by e_{m+1-q},...,e_p (empty when m+1-q>p): no smaller subscript occurs, and taking i=1 lets j realize every listed subscript. The rank is max(0,p+q-m). Summing the printed block decomposition and applying rank-nullity therefore gives the entire frozen conditional count, not just its endpoint. Switching to upper Jordan blocks by reversing the basis does not change rank. The alternative truncated-polynomial proof is concise but does not change the mathematical invariant or produce an additional noncovered law.

originality.rationale: The arbitrary-partition count is mathematically correct, but it is mechanically implied by the explicit rectangular operator evaluation in Prasad–Singla–Spallone, arXiv:1212.6157v2, §6.2, pp. 20–21. This is stronger evidence than prior knowledge of the linearized-power operator itself: the authors give its action on matrix units and the resulting coordinate vector on the first column for arbitrary rectangular sizes and exponent. In the claimed range, the first column determines the whole output. The closed count need not have been printed in that source to be covered. Earlier Resultary records also state the one-block distribution and the arbitrary-block top mass explicitly. The originality failure does not rest on inaccessible literature or on later overlapping records.

value.rationale: The fixed-residue distribution is a natural invariant, and the formula is convenient. But its exact value is already obtained by reading off the first-column image from the prior all-rectangular matrix-unit computation, followed by rank-nullity. The top probability is explicitly covered by an earlier record, and the alternative proof is a reformulation of the same computation with no independent further finding. No distinct valuable remainder of the stated theorem survives that coverage, so no repair is submitted.
